eyebrow: Create a share, add a table
caption: WITH HISTORY is a deliberate choice — it lets the recipient run time-travel queries and streaming reads.

code:
CREATE RECIPIENT IF NOT EXISTS logistics_partner
  USING ID 'aws:us-west-2:a1b2c3d4-5678-90ab-cdef-1234567890ab';
caption: USING ID points at the partner's own metastore — no token management required for D2D sharing.
SHOW GRANTS answers "who can see this outside our metastore" — REVOKE cuts access off immediately, no lingering copy.
